definitions.explanation: Equipment worn to protect the body from injury, used in sports like kendo, baseball, and other activities.
Armor or protective equipment used historically in battle or in fantasy/game contexts.

examples.japanese: {剣道|けんどう}の{防具|ぼうぐ}は{手入|てい}れが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Maintaining kendo protective gear is important.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{前|まえ}に{防具|ぼうぐ}をしっかり{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check your protective gear carefully before the match.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}は{防具|ぼうぐ}を{身|み}につけて{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: Samurai wore armor and fought in battle.

examples.japanese: このゲームでは{強|つよ}い{防具|ぼうぐ}を{手|て}に{入|い}れると{有利|ゆうり}になる。
examples.english: In this game, obtaining strong armor gives you an advantage.

examples.japanese: {博物館|はくぶつかん}に{展示|てんじ}されている{中世|ちゅうせい}の{防具|ぼうぐ}は{保存|ほぞん}{状態|じょうたい}がよい。
examples.english: The medieval armor displayed in the museum is in good condition.

notes:
Most commonly associated with kendo gear in modern Japanese. The full set of kendo {防具|ぼうぐ} consists of {面|めん} (face guard), {胴|どう} (torso protector), {小手|こて} (gauntlets), and {垂|たれ} (waist protector).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防具|ぼうぐ}を{着|つ}ける (put on protective gear)
- {防具|ぼうぐ}を{外|はず}す (take off protective gear)
- {防具|ぼうぐ}を{装備|そうび}する (equip armor — games)

RELATED WORDS:
- {武具|ぶぐ} covers both offensive and defensive equipment
- {甲冑|かっちゅう} refers specifically to historical Japanese armor
